The lady with the disadvantageous, heavy makeup had the worst day of her life having to do her job. I honestly don't know how her colleagues can stand it, after about 5 minutes I would have either slapped her or quit.
I wanted to receive a package. I greeted her kindly, then told her that I wanted to receive a package. To this she started rolling her eyes mockingly and asked back, "CsOMagoot?" 🙄 I repeated it kindly. Then I got reactions and emphasis that even the villains in Disney movies would envy. This woman shouldn't be allowed to go out among people, let alone get paid for it. Then she asked for my ID, which I didn't have. I indicated that I could prove myself with Dáp. She specifically laughed at me and instructed me that she couldn't accept it. She gave me my package with great difficulty, but there was no thank you in it. Then he said that next time I should ask for it at the parcel machine, and then I wouldn't do it like that. Interestingly, this has never occurred to me at any other collection point. But one thing is for sure, I WILL NOT COME here again. Neither to buy nor to collect a parcel. Even though I have had good experiences here before

The worst shopping experience I have ever had.
I bought a veterinary medicine from AlphaZoo, and it was spoiled and poorly stored. The packaging was already damaged, and the product smelled bad.

When I went back the next day to explain, instead of helping me, they told me to still give this medicine to my dog and insisted that it was fine. This is absolutely irresponsible and dangerous!

After two days, my dog got sick and started vomiting. This shows that the medicine was not in proper condition. Their storage conditions are terrible, and their customer service is unacceptable.

I will never trust them again.
